dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you a craftsman of a sort, then?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Haha, I don't suppose I count. Just a barely-competent grease monkey, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Before coming here, I worked in the Fontaine Research Institute, and so I've rented this shop with Miss Cairuo. I just help people fix some simple mechanisms, and enjoy the company of my daughter. We get by.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: If the problem's too complicated, or if some core parts are busted up, then our clients will have to find help somewhere else.
